name: Random Number Predictor (随机数预测)
author: JiesiLuo
description: Hover a card, potion, pile, event option or rest-site option to see what its random effect will actually do: generated cards, random targets, transformations, upgrades, relics, shuffle order. F8 toggles. | 悬停到卡牌、药水、牌堆、事件选项或休息点选项上，直接看到随机效果的真实结果：生成的牌、随机目标、变化结果、升级的牌、随机遗物、洗牌顺序。F8 开关。灵感来自一代的随机数预测大师。
